description: OVN System Overview Dashboard for monitoring Open Virtual Network infrastructure health and performance

panels.description: Version information about the OVN installation including system ID, OVN version, and database schema version.

targets.expr: max by (hostname, nb_schema_version, sb_schema_version, system_type, system_version) (ovn_info)

panels.title: OVN Info

panels.description: Table showing all OVN chassis with their last configuration sync timestamp. Active chassis show a recent timestamp (green). No Data (red) means the chassis is not reporting. Not Reporting (orange) indicates a timestamp of 0.
panels.title: Chassis Information

panels.description: Current system availability percentage. Calculated as the average of all OVN stack status values. 100% means all monitored OVN components are healthy.
panels.title: System Availability

panels.description: Rate of failed requests to OVN stack components per minute. High values indicate connectivity or performance issues with OVN databases.
panels.title: Failed Requests Rate

panels.description: Distribution of OVN chassis across the cluster. Each chassis represents a hypervisor or network node running ovn-controller.
panels.title: Chassis Distribution

panels.description: Total number of unique logical switches defined in the OVN Northbound database. Logical switches provide L2 network segments.
panels.title: Total Logical Switches

panels.description: Total number of unique logical switch ports across all logical switches. Each port represents a virtual network interface connected to the OVN network.
panels.title: Total Logical Ports

panels.description: Total number of unique logical routers defined in OVN. Logical routers provide L3 routing between logical switches and external networks.
panels.title: Total Logical Routers

panels.description: Whether this OVN exporter instance sees itself as the Raft cluster leader for Northbound (NB) and Southbound (SB) databases. Leader (green) handles all write operations; Follower (blue) replicates from the leader.
panels.title: Cluster Leader Status (per node)

panels.description: Number of peers in each OVN database cluster. For high availability, you should have at least 3 peers (odd number for quorum). Values below 2 indicate a degraded cluster that may lose quorum.
panels.title: Cluster Peer Count

panels.description: Current status of the OVN stack. UP (green) means the OVN exporter can successfully connect to all OVN components. DOWN (red) indicates connection failures.
panels.title: OVN Stack Status

panels.description: Raft log high index for each OVN cluster database. This represents the number of committed log entries in the Raft consensus protocol. Steadily increasing values indicate healthy cluster operation.
panels.title: Cluster Raft Log Index

panels.description: Size of OVN component log files in bytes. Monitor for unexpected growth which could indicate excessive logging or issues requiring attention.
panels.title: Log File Sizes

panels.description: Current role of each cluster member in the Raft consensus protocol. Values: 3=Leader (actively serving writes), 2=Candidate (running for election), 1=Follower (replicating from leader). Watch for frequent role changes which indicate cluster instability.
panels.title: Cluster Role (3=leader, 2=candidate, 1=follower)

panels.description: Time since each chassis last synchronized its configuration from the OVN Southbound database. Values above 60s (yellow) or 300s (red) indicate sync delays that may cause network configuration drift.
panels.title: Config Sync Lag per Chassis

panels.description: The nb_cfg (Northbound Configuration) sequence number for each chassis. This number increases when configuration changes are propagated. All chassis should have matching or close values; divergence indicates replication lag.
panels.title: NB Config Sequence per Chassis

panels.description: Current Raft term for each cluster. The term increases with each leader election. Frequent term increases indicate cluster instability or network issues between cluster members.
panels.title: Cluster Term (Leader Elections)

panels.description: Number of Raft leader elections in the last 5 minutes. Occasional elections during maintenance or node restarts are normal. Frequent elections (>2 yellow, >5 red) indicate cluster health issues.
panels.title: Leader Elections (last 5m)

panels.description: Number of Raft log entries that have been committed but not yet applied. High values indicate the server is falling behind in processing updates. Persistent non-zero values may indicate performance issues.
panels.title: Cluster Pending Entries

panels.description: Per-chassis count of chassisredirect port bindings — the distributed-router egress anchors that carry centralized N/S (SNAT) traffic. Rebalances (cr-lrp chassis moves) show up as abrupt steps across this stack. With enable_distributed_floating_ip=True the floating-IP path is NOT reflected here; FIP egress is distributed per-compute.
panels.title: N/S Gateway Port Distribution by Chassis

panels.description: Drill-down of chassis-pinned gateway port bindings (chassisredirect + l3gateway). For Neutron deployments, router_name is the router UUID behind the cr-lrp. Sort by chassis to spot pile-ups.
panels.title: Gateway Port to Router Mapping

title: OVN System Overview
